# uptimekuma_notification_sendgrid (Resource)

SendGrid notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_sendgrid" "example" {
  name       = "SendGrid Notifications"
  api_key    = "SG.your-api-key-here"
  to_email   = "alerts@example.com"
  from_email = "monitoring@example.com"
  subject    = "Uptime Alert Notification"
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_sendgrid" "with_cc_bcc" {
  name       = "SendGrid with CC/BCC"
  api_key    = "SG.your-api-key-here"
  to_email   = "alerts@example.com"
  from_email = "monitoring@example.com"
  subject    = "Critical Alert"
  cc_email   = "team-lead@example.com"
  bcc_email  = "archive@example.com"
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: api_key_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change api_key_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_sendgrid" "write_only" {
  name = "SendGrid with a write-only secret"

  to_email   = "alerts@example.com"
  from_email = "monitoring@example.com"
  subject    = "Uptime Alert Notification"

  api_key_wo         = "SG.your-api-key-here"
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_email` (String) Sender email address
- `name` (String) Notification name
- `subject` (String) Email subject
- `to_email` (String) Recipient email address

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) SendGrid API key. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SendGrid API key, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `bcc_email` (String) BCC email addresses
- `cc_email` (String) CC email addresses
- `is_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
